rules.title: No Bluffing
rules.description: Transcribed from src/match/rules/no_bluffing.cpp. A deny entry rejects playing the +4 (face label jolly_draw4) while the player holds a card whose colour equals the active type; the compound predicate is WP7e's plays_bluffing, which is the named violation form of legacy no_bluffing.cpp:12-30.
